hook: Stop losing work when you switch branches

scenes.narration: Stop losing work when you switch branches
scenes.title: git stash
scenes.subtitle: Save work instantly

scenes.narration: Run git stash to shelve changes, switch branch, then git stash pop to restore
scenes.code:
# Shelve your current changes
git stash

# Switch to another branch
git checkout main

# Restore your changes
git stash pop

scenes.narration: Three simple steps: stash, switch, pop
steps: git stash — shelves all tracked changes
git stash pop — restore and continue

scenes.narration: Pro tip: name your stash with git stash push -m
scenes.message:
Pro tip: name it!
git stash push -m "my feature"
